name: SVC_WO_AREA_CONFIG_KEYS
description: Table used to store work order configuration key mapping information, for mapping properties in Oracle Field Service to B2B Field Service. WO_KEY_ID is the primary key in this table.

columns.name: WO_KEY_ID
columns.description: An autogenerated number and primary key for the SVC_WO_AREA_CONFIG_KEYS table.

columns.name: FS_PROPERTY_NAME
columns.description: Property used to identify the name of the Oracle Field Service property.

columns.name: KEY_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the type of configuration key created.

columns.name: CONNECTION_CD
columns.description: The foreign key referencing the CONNECTION_CD in the SVC_WO_CONNECTIONS table.

columns.name: CONFIG_ID
columns.description: The foreign key that maps this record to the SVC_WO_AREA_CONFIGS table.

columns.name: CONFIG_NUMBER
columns.description: The foreign key that maps this record to the SVC_WO_AREA_CONFIGS table.

columns.name: WO_FIELD
columns.description: Property used to identify a work order field that maps to the FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY.

columns.name: FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY
columns.description: Property used to identify the Oracle Field Service Cloud work zone key property that maps to the WO_FIELD.

columns.name: FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY_LENGTH
columns.description: Property used to identify the Oracle Field Service Cloud work zone key length.

columns.name: FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY_ORDER
columns.description: Property used to identify the Oracle Field Service Cloud work zone key order.

columns.name: FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY_CASE
columns.description: Property used to identify the Oracle Field Service Cloud work zone key case sensitivity.

columns.name: FS_PROPERTY_LABEL
columns.description: Property used to identify the property label of the FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY.

columns.name: FS_PROPERTY_TYPE
columns.description: Property used to identify the property type of the FS_WORK_ZONE_KEY.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_RETRIEVAL_DATE
columns.description: Property used to identify the date when the record was last pulled from Oracle Field Service.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FS_API_PARAM_NAME
columns.description: Property used to identify the parameter name of the Oracle Field Service property.
